overview: Based on the published agenda, the Administrative Policy Committee of Kronenwetter was scheduled to review financial reports, consider the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program budget, and address several policy matters including municipal center hours, public comment procedures, and a dual service ordinance affecting the Police and Fire Commission.

discussions.item: Comparative Internal Financial Statements Year-To-Date: August 2026
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review comparative internal financial statements for the year-to-date period through August 2026. This report was expected to provide financial performance data for the village's operations.

The committee was set to review state aids allocations that would inform the 2027 budget planning process. This discussion was expected to address revenue sources available to the village for the upcoming fiscal year.

discussions.item: August 2026 Financial Statistical Report from Wisconsin Policy Forum
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to consider financial statistical information from the Wisconsin Policy Forum for August 2026. This external report was expected to provide comparative analysis or benchmarking data for the village's finances.

The committee was set to review the second draft of the Capital Improvements Program budget covering the ten-year period from 2027 to 2036. This item was expected to guide long-term capital planning and infrastructure decisions for the village.

discussions.item: Debt Service Fund Tax Levy Strategy
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss the tax levy strategy related to the debt service fund. This discussion was expected to address how the village would finance debt obligations through tax levy allocations.
The committee was set to consider and possibly act on changes to the hours of operation for the Municipal Center. This item was expected to address operational scheduling for the village facility.

discussions.item: Written Public Comment Procedures for Village Meetings
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss and possibly adopt procedures governing written public comments submitted to village meetings. This discussion was expected to establish or clarify how the village would accept and process written comments from the public.

discussions.item: Ordinance 14-16 (Police and Fire Commission and Utilities Committee Dual Service)
discussions.body: The committee was set to consider Ordinance 14-16 regarding dual service by members of the Police and Fire Commission and the Utilities Committee. This item was expected to address policies related to individuals serving on multiple village boards simultaneously.

The committee was scheduled to receive a preview of the 2027 operating budget, including separate reviews of proposed utility funds and operating and capital funds. This discussion was expected to prepare the committee for detailed budget deliberations.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, with a maximum of 15 minutes total and three minutes per person, subject to extension at the presiding officer's discretion.
